summary: Keros Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026 disclosing that its board approved a $5 million common-stock repurchase program, funded after receipt of a $20 million development milestone from Takeda under the elritercept license following first-patient dosing in the ELRiSE MDS trial. No price per share, premium, expiration, or advisor was stated. Repurchases may occur in the open market or otherwise, at management's discretion, subject to market conditions and contractual limits, and may be modified, suspended, or discontinued. Cash was $257.6 million as of June 30, 2026, with runway into 2H 2028. Watch actual buyback pace, liquidity, and pipeline catalysts.
